365.25 days/year * 24 hours/day * 60 minutes/hour * 60 seconds/minute = 31,558,140 seconds/year

Next, calculate the distance light travels in a year (light-year):

299,792,458 m/s * 31,558,140 s ≈ 9,460,730,472,580.8 meters

Converting meters to miles (1 mile = approximately 1.60934 kilometers or 1,609.34 meters):

9,460,730,472,580.8 meters / 1,609.34 meters/mile ≈ 5,878,625,373,183.61 miles

So, one light-year is approximately 5.88 trillion miles. Therefore, the distance covered in one light year is roughly 5.88 trillion miles.
